Virtues: Conviction and Instinct

Followers (Corruptors/Slaves) believe vampires are agents of Hell, with the Beast as a demon given at Embrace. Each Slave learns a personal mandate from their demonic patron - specific vices to promote or virtues to undermine - and works to corrupt others, mortal and vampire alike, in service of infernal masters. Both the Sabbat and Camarilla hunt this Path's followers as heretics.

Hierarchy of Sin (most to least severe):

  1. Disobeying or failing to serve your demonic patron
  2. Failing to persuade or corrupt other vampires toward demonic agendas
  3. Failing to fight vampires who pursue goodness or honor
  4. Telling the truth without gaining advantage from the lie withheld
  5. Restraining the Beast instead of exploiting it

Typical followers: often found in nomadic packs for secrecy; favors Auspex, Presence, Dark Thaumaturgy, Dementation.
